card.name: First word after a colon introducing a list
card.fires_on: The first word right after a colon (or a list comma) that introduces a list of conditions, in label text such as contraindications, screening and dosing lead-ins. Typically "in", "for" or "the".

modes.label: After contraindicated:
modes.description: Linking word "in" or "for" straight after "is contraindicated:" in a contraindications section.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS QUVIVIQ is contraindicated:<< in>> patients with narcolepsy.

modes.label: After assess: or dependent on:
modes.description: Linking word after a colon that starts a list of things to check or consider.

modes.label: Inside a symptom list
modes.description: A comma or opening word within a short list of symptoms or conditions.
modes.example: Symptoms of serotonin syndrome may include: agitation<<,>> confusion seeing or hearing things that are not

card.writes: It promotes list and colon-like punctuation tokens, which suggests it helps set up the formatting of list items.
card.plain: It fires on the first small word after a colon that opens a list in a drug label, such as "contraindicated: in".
